account.accindex.desc: A CHAR(12) primary key uniquely identifying each account record (e.g., 'AC1234567890')

account.acctident.desc: A VARCHAR(14) field holding an external-facing or system-defined account identifier (e.g., 'ACC2686094')

account.platident.desc: An 8-character field indicating which platform ID the account is associated with (e.g., 'PL784')

account.plattype.desc: An enum (PlatformType_enum) describing the platform type (Microblog, Social Network, Video Platform, Forum)

account.acctcreatedate.desc: A DATE indicating when the account was created (e.g., '2025-02-20')

account.acctagespan.desc: A SMALLINT showing the account’s age in days since creation (e.g., '45')

account.acctstatus.desc: An enum (AccountStatus_enum) capturing the account status (Active, Deleted, Suspended, Dormant)

account.acctcategory.desc: An enum (AccountType_enum) labeling the account type (Personal, Bot, Hybrid, Business)

account.authstatus.desc: An enum (VerificationStatus_enum) describing the verification state (Unverified, Pending, Failed, Suspicious)

contentbehavior.cntref.desc: A CHAR(12) primary key for each content behavior record (e.g., 'CB1234567890')

contentbehavior.cntlangnum.desc: An enum (ContentLanguageCount_enum) showing language count in posts (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5)

contentbehavior.hashusepat.desc: An enum (HashtagUsagePattern_enum) describing hashtag usage (Trending, Normal, Random, Spam)

contentbehavior.hashratio.desc: NUMERIC(3,2) fraction of posts with at least one hashtag (e.g., '0.23')

contentbehavior.mentionpat.desc: An enum (MentionPattern_enum) describing mention usage (Normal, Random, Targeted, Spam)

contentbehavior.mentionratio.desc: NUMERIC(5,3) fraction of posts with mentions (e.g., '0.568')

contentbehavior.urlsharefreq.desc: A VARCHAR(24) showing how often URLs are shared (e.g., 'HighFreq')

contentbehavior.urldomdiv.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) domain diversity among shared URLs (e.g., '1.23')

contentbehavior.mediaupratio.desc: NUMERIC(5,3) fraction of posts including media (e.g., '0.345')

contentbehavior.mediareratio.desc: NUMERIC(6,4) how often the same media is reused (e.g., '0.2345')

messaginganalysis.msgkey.desc: A CHAR(12) primary key for each messaging analysis record (e.g., 'MA1234567890')

messaginganalysis.convnatval.desc: NUMERIC(4,3) how natural conversation flow is (e.g., '0.753')

moderationaction.modactkey.desc: A CHAR(12) primary key uniquely identifying each moderation action record (e.g., 'MA0000001234')

moderationaction.abuserepnum.desc: A SMALLINT counting how many abuse reports (e.g., '2')

moderationaction.susphist.desc: An enum (SuspensionHistory_enum) detailing past suspensions (0 through 5)

moderationaction.warnnum.desc: A SMALLINT showing how many warnings were issued (e.g., '1')

moderationaction.appealnum.desc: An enum (AppealCount_enum) for how many appeals were filed (0 through 5)

moderationaction.investstatus.desc: An enum (InvestigationStatus_enum) describing investigation status (Pending, Active, Completed)

moderationaction.actiontaken.desc: An enum (ActionTaken_enum) summarizing final moderation (Suspension, Warning, Restriction)

moderationaction.reviewfreq.desc: An enum (ReviewFrequency_enum) describing re-review frequency (Monthly, Quarterly, Daily, Weekly)

moderationaction.lastrevdate.desc: A DATE showing last moderation review (e.g., '2025-03-20')

moderationaction.nextrevdate.desc: A DATE scheduling the next moderation review (e.g., '2025-04-20')

sessionbehavior.loginlocvar.desc: NUMERIC(4,1) measuring variance in login locations (e.g., '2.7')

technicalinfo.proxycount.desc: A SMALLINT counting times a proxy was detected (e.g., '2')
